steps.action: In packages/spawner/src/aurora_spawner/spawner.py, resolve all mypy --strict violations (using the repo's mypy.ini strict settings) without touching any files under packages/spawner/tests/. Do not add blanket '# type: ignore' suppressions, do not relax mypy.ini, and do not modify any file under packages/spawner/tests/. Keep iterating until the whole package passes strict typecheck.
